output.summary: The claim was denied because the required supervised weight‑loss program record is missing. To proceed, collect the needed evidence and appeal using the specified coverage clause.

items.text: Obtain a record confirming completion of the six‑month supervised weight‑loss program as required by the bariatric surgery clause.
Collect the supervised weight‑loss program record per playbook step PB-COVERAGE-CRITERIA-S1.
Submit an appeal citing clause C-2025-BARIATRIC (section 7.4) following playbook step PB-COVERAGE-CRITERIA-S2.
Precedent F-GENETIC does not apply because it addresses genetic testing exclusions under a different clause, not bariatric surgery coverage.
